# Luv Braces

> > Premier orthodontics and pediatric dentistry provider in Austin and Bee Cave, Texas, offering Invisalign, clear braces, metal braces, and kids dentistry services.

Luv Braces is a full-service orthodontic and pediatric dental practice led by Dr. Amirali Tahbaz and Dr. Mona Rezapour, serving patients of all ages across two locations in Austin and Bee Cave, Texas. The practice specializes in modern orthodontic treatments including Invisalign clear aligners, ceramic braces, and traditional metal braces, along with comprehensive pediatric dentistry services.
